source_basis.work: 中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下册）

major_findings: TP02 continues the Property Palace multi-scope model: property/inheritance/preservation, service-institution context, relocation, disputes, environmental sensitivity, family relations, path dependence and event candidates stay typed separately.
Nine archived condition surfaces required source-preserving correction; several other rows preserve damaged/nonstandard printed glyphs instead of silently normalizing them.
TP02-103 restores the Sun-Moon base structure and annual adverse relation scope.
TP02-135 restores 火星同躔 + 虚耗刑忌 + 流煞冲会; TP02-136 keeps only the clearly readable fire-risk tail and quarantines the damaged preceding clause.
TP02-150 restores 更见煞忌重重 as the stronger gate for litigation.
TP02-175/176 preserve 流年及小限 as source scope while leaving 小限 unmapped to runtime.
TP02-191 restores distinct relation surfaces and preserves branch-scope ambiguity.
TP02-200 removes 空劫夹 from the relocation/sale condition and records the separate source-explicit 空劫夹亦主破败 branch as an unassigned source gap.
